recentItems.title: Ravens Offensive Preview and Fantasy Wide Receivers to Draft
recentItems.description:
Mike Yam reports on the latest news from across the NFL, including updates on the Seahawks sale and the new tackling rules that promote player safety. He also delivers interview clips from quarterbacks around the league as they prepare for the 2026 season.  

Then, NFL analyst Trevor Sikkema joins the show to discuss what to expect from Lamar Jackson and the Ravens and Gregg Rosenthal drops by to tell you which players to watch in week three of the preseason. Trevor also shares his favorite wide receivers to draft in fantasy and you’ll find out why the NFL is getting rid of the Pro Bowl.

recentItems.title: Making Roster Moves and Fmr Pro Bowl OT Terron Armstead | Lots to Say
recentItems.description:
Bobby Bones and Matt Cassel have breaking news with Matt's schedule of calling games this season!  Matt explains how he's practicing and reveals the games he's working.  Onto the games, Deshaun Watson is named the Browns starter and Matt recalls fans cheering when he was injured.  As rosters get cut down, Bobby asks how much Matt would want to know about his status in the final weeks.  Bobby gives his thoughts on the possibility of NFL players going back to play college football.

5x Pro Bowl OT Terron Armstead talks about being on the track team while playing football.  Terron looks back at Drew Brees as a person and a player.  Matt asks about the prep Terron would have to put in to matchup witn an elite pass rusher.  Terron explains why he's never been a trash-talker why most of his opponents didn't talk either.  What does Terron expect from QB Tyler Shough and HC Kellen Moore?  

Lots to Say with Bobby Bones and Matt Cassel is part of the NFL Podcast Network
